replies.author: de0u
replies.text:
JdawGraphene How, if at all can I save the data from this phone.

You might try taking it to a repair shop. If something has gone mechanically wrong with heat management, perhaps that can be addressed. A tech might have a way to find a hot chip and to chill it. Another option might be a forensic recovery service.

JdawGraphene I was hoping getting another 6pro and taking that I need from that to get it functional again. Thoughts much appreciated.

I don't expect that end-user part-swapping is very likely to work. The motherboard is basically one unit, except for people with really good equipment and skills.

replies.author: 23Sha-ger
replies.text:
JdawGraphene for a few seconds then screen freezes again

This might be just a screen problem. You can easily check it - next time your phone freezes, try

to call it or see if there is any network activity in your router (must be connected to wifi)

Some half dead screens can freeze the picture, some can turn on and then go off all of the sudden, etc.

replies.author: de0u
replies.text:
JdawGraphene It took and wrote the release fine but still wont go past graphene logo after boot.

Unfortunately that is consistent with a hardware problem. If it is a heat problem, an expert tech might be able to identify and work around the heat problem.

At this point it seems unlikely that any standard operation (sideloading, safe mode) will be productive. It's not clear that an expert can help, but I think it's the only possibly-productive path.
